name: Pekat Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Pekat Group Berhad 的间接持股60%子公司 EPE Switchgear (M) Sdn. Bhd. 以约 RM30.58 million 收购了位于 Negeri Sembilan、Mukim Labu 的六块永久工业用地，用于扩大业务。同时，公司对一家已停止运营的间接全资子公司 E & LP Engineering Sdn. Bhd. 进行成员自愿清盘。此外，公司与 Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia 的谅解备忘录在年内多次更新，但均无重大进展。
overview_en: In 2026, EPE Switchgear (M) Sdn. Bhd., an indirect 60%-owned subsidiary of Pekat Group Berhad, acquired six freehold industrial land parcels in Mukim Labu, Negeri Sembilan, for approximately RM30.58 million to expand its operations. Meanwhile, the company undertook a member's voluntary winding-up of its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary E & LP Engineering Sdn. Bhd., which had ceased operations.

actions.text: 间接全资子公司 E & LP Engineering Sdn. Bhd.（从事电气产品及配件分销，自2023年起停止运营）进行成员自愿清盘。
